categories.intro_uz: Nur — portretning kayfiyati. Bitta kod bilan oddiy selfini oltin soat, studiya yoki sham nuriga o‘tkazasiz.
Analog plyonka uslublari: Kodak iliqligi, Polaroid xiraligi, donador tekstura va eski suratlar nafosati.
Kino kadrlari kabi: teal-orange gradatsiya, noir soyalar, keng ekran va dramatik kontrast.
Klassik monoxrom — rangni olib tashlab, his-tuyg‘u, nur va shaklni birinchi o‘ringa qo‘yamiz.
Rang palitrasi bilan ishlash: iliq, sovuq, pastel, to‘yingan yoki xira tuslar.
Yumshoq nur, mayin porlash, pushti tuslar — nafis va orzuli portretlar uchun.
Ijtimoiy tarmoqlardagi eng mashhur estetikalar: dark academia, old money, coquette va boshqalar.
Professional retush: silliq teri, yorqin ko‘zlar, oq tishlar, yuz konturi — tabiiylikni saqlagan holda.
Fonni o‘zgartiring: studiya, gradient, bokeh yoki qog‘oz — odam o‘zgarmaydi, muhit o‘zgaradi.
Suratni san’at asariga aylantiring: moyli rasm, akvarel, qalam eskizi, pop-art va komiks.
Polaroid, plyonka lentasi, jurnal muqovasi, vintage ramka — surat uchun tayyor «kiyim».
Glitch, VHS, ikki ekspozitsiya, prizma, linza chaqnashi — surat uchun kuchli vizual effektlar.
Bir surat — to‘rt fasl: kuz oltini, qish sovug‘i, bahor nafasi, yoz quyoshi, yomg‘ir va tuman.
Chang, qog‘oz, bokeh, uchqunlar, jalyuzi va barg soyalari — suratga chuqurlik beruvchi qatlamlar.
Duotone, neon, kiberpank, retro-poster, rizograf — jasur va zamonaviy tajribalar.

codes.desc_uz: Quyosh botishidan oldingi iliq, oltin nur. Teri yumshoq porlaydi, soyalar iliq jigarrang tusga kiradi.
codes.prompt_en: Apply a golden-hour look: warm low sunlight from the side, soft golden glow on the skin, gentle haze and warm brown shadows.
codes.hint: temperature +0.35; split_tone shadows #5a3626 / highlights #ffd27a strength .4; directional warm light: screen a linear() gradient from top-right tinted #ffb15a; glow(sigma 40, .35, .55); vignette .2 warm (#2a1608). Skin must stay natural, not orange-saturated.

codes.desc_uz: Bulut orqali o‘tgan tarqoq, tekis nur. Qattiq soyalar yo‘qoladi, teri tekis va mayin ko‘rinadi.
codes.prompt_en: Relight the photo with soft, diffused light: no harsh shadows, gentle contrast, even skin, airy and clean.
codes.hint: lift shadows with curve [(0,.06),(.3,.36),(1,.97)]; contrast .9; lighten face_skin slightly (+.04 via mask); orton(sigma 20, .3); slight desat .92; NO vignette. Must look brighter and creamier than the original.

codes.desc_uz: Professional studiya: toza, neytral fon, yuzga yo‘naltirilgan asosiy nur va aniq detallar.
codes.prompt_en: Turn this into a professional studio portrait: neutral dark-grey seamless backdrop, key light on the face, crisp detail, clean colours.
codes.hint: replace_background with a dark grey radial gradient (#3a3436 centre behind head -> #1c1a1b edges, use radial() centred slightly above face_center); clarity .3; brighten face via radial mask centred on face (+.08); catchlight: slight brighten on iris mask; rim: edge_band(person) screen at .25 white. Keep subject colours natural.

codes.desc_uz: Orqadan tushayotgan nur odamning silueti bo‘ylab yorqin chiziq hosil qiladi — chuqurlik va hajm beradi.
codes.prompt_en: Add a backlight rim light: a bright warm-white edge of light tracing the outline of the hair/hijab and shoulders, background slightly darker.
codes.hint: darken background (bg mask) by .35 and cool it slightly; rim = inner_edge(mask("person"), width 16, softness 7) * linear(angle 45 from top-right) -> screen with warm white #ffe9c4 at .9; add faint glow(blur of the rim). Rim must be clearly visible along hijab/shoulders.

codes.desc_uz: Derazadan tushayotgan yumshoq kunduzgi nur va jalyuzi soyalari — tinch, uy muhiti.
codes.prompt_en: Relight with soft window light: gentle directional daylight from the left with faint venetian-blind shadow bands across the scene.
codes.hint: stripes(angle 12, period 120, duty .45, softness 14) darkening at .35 (multiply), skip strongest darkening on the face (reduce by face mask *.5); light gradient from left screen #fff2dc .25; temperature +.12; contrast .95; subtle glow. Bands should read as real window light, not a texture overlay.

codes.desc_uz: Issiq, xira sham nuri: yuz iliq-oltin, atrof qorong‘i va shirin romantik kayfiyat.
codes.prompt_en: Relight as if lit only by candlelight: warm orange-amber glow on the face, dark soft surroundings, intimate mood, gentle grain.
codes.hint: darken overall exposure -1.1 stops except a radial warm light centred low-left of face (radius .55, softness .8) that keeps face near original brightness; temperature +.55; split_tone #2a0e05 / #ffb050 .5; glow .3; grain .06; vignette .5 #150804. Face must remain clearly visible.

codes.desc_uz: Tungi sovuq ko‘k oy nuri: kumushrang yorug‘lik, chuqur soyalar va sirli sokinlik.
codes.prompt_en: Relight as a moonlit night: cool blue-silver light, deep soft shadows, desaturated colours, calm mysterious mood.
codes.hint: exposure -1.2; temperature -.5; saturation .55; split_tone #0b1a3a / #cfe0ff .45; radial silver light from top-left (screen #dbe8ff .3); soft moon disc glow in top-left corner (radial small + blur); glow .25; grain .04; vignette .45 #05091a.

codes.desc_uz: Pushti-apelsin quyosh botishi nuri: osmon shaftoli rangda, yuzda iliq shu’la.
codes.prompt_en: Add a sunset glow: peach-pink and orange light from behind, warm skin, soft flare and a pastel purple tint in the shadows.
codes.hint: gradient overlay: linear(angle 90) top #ff9a6a -> bottom #7a4b8a screened at .45 (stronger on background mask); temperature +.3; split_tone #4a2a5c / #ffbe8a .45; lens_flare small at top-right (strength .5, no ghosts); glow .35.

codes.desc_uz: Bulutli kunning sovuq, tekis va yumshoq nuri — minimalistik, tinch, skandinav uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Make the light overcast: cool even daylight, low contrast, muted colours, soft grey-blue mood, no harsh highlights.
codes.hint: temperature -.25; saturation .75; contrast .85 pivot .55; fade .05; curve pull highlights [(0,0),(.8,.74),(1,.93)]; slight blue in shadows via color_balance shadows (-.02,0,.04). Should read clearly cooler and flatter than the original.

codes.desc_uz: Sahna projektori: faqat yuz yoritilgan, atrof qorong‘ilikka cho‘kadi — dramatik va teatral.
codes.prompt_en: Light the portrait with a single dramatic spotlight on the face; everything around falls into deep darkness, theatrical mood.
codes.hint: light = radial(centre face_center, radius .5, softness .75); img = lerp(img*0.08, img*1.05, light); slight warm tint on the lit area; glow .2; grain .04. Face fully lit, edges near black but with soft falloff (not a hard circle).

codes.desc_uz: Mashhur Kodak Gold plyonkasi: iliq sariq-oltin tuslar, yumshoq qizil ranglar, yengil donadorlik.
codes.prompt_en: Emulate Kodak Gold 200 film: warm golden-yellow highlights, soft saturated reds, slightly lifted shadows, fine film grain.
codes.hint: per-channel curves: r [(0,.02),(.5,.55),(1,1)], g [(0,.02),(.5,.52),(1,.98)], b [(0,.06),(.5,.46),(1,.9)]; hsl_adjust green hue 120 -> shift +15 sat .9 (greens go yellowish); vibrance .2; grain .05; slight warm vignette. Distinctly golden vs original.

codes.desc_uz: Fujifilm uslubi: yashil-moviy salqin tuslar, mayin teri va nostalgik ko‘rinish.
codes.prompt_en: Emulate Fujifilm colour negative: cool minty greens, soft cyan highlights, muted magenta shadows, gentle film grain.
codes.hint: hsl_adjust greens 120 width 45 shift -10 sat 1.15 lum +.05 (mint); split_tone #3a2a45 / #cfeee0 .4; curves b [(0,.05),(.5,.52),(1,.97)]; saturation .9; fade .06; grain .05.

codes.desc_uz: Tezkor Polaroid surat: xira, iliq-salqin aralash tuslar, past kontrast va klassik oq ramka.
codes.prompt_en: Make it look like an instant Polaroid photo: washed-out faded colours, slight cyan-yellow cast, low contrast, classic white instant-film frame.
codes.hint: look: fade .12, saturation .8, temperature +.1 with slight cyan in highlights (color_balance highlights (-.03,0,.03)), vignette .25, grain .05. Then paste() onto a beige canvas with paper(): photo size ~ (760, 950) white border 46 and bottom border 190, rotate -3, drop shadow. Add a tiny handwritten-style caption (cormorant-italic) on the bottom border e.g. "yoz ‘26".

codes.desc_uz: Ko‘rinarli nozik plyonka donalari va biroz xira ranglar — haqiqiy analog tuyg‘u.
codes.prompt_en: Add authentic visible film grain across the photo, slightly muted colours and a touch of softness like real 35mm film.
codes.hint: grain amount .13 size 1.6 mono; saturation .88; fade .05; unsharp tiny; slight warm. Grain must be clearly visible at full size but not noisy-ugly.

codes.desc_uz: 90-yillar kompakt kamerasi: flesh nuri, sarg‘ish tus va burchakdagi orange sana tamg‘asi.
codes.prompt_en: Recreate a 1990s point-and-shoot snapshot: flash-lit look, warm yellowish cast, slight overexposure, soft focus and an orange date stamp in the corner.
codes.hint: exposure +.25 with highlights compressed; temperature +.3; slight green tint -.08; soft_focus mix .25; grain .06; vignette .2; draw date stamp "’96 8 15" bottom-right in orange #ff8a1e using lato-bold ~54px, tracking 4, with a soft glow (shadow same colour, blur 5).

codes.desc_uz: Matoviy, xira qoralar va pastel ranglar — vaqt o‘tgan surat kabi mayin ko‘rinish.
codes.prompt_en: Give the photo a faded matte film look: lifted milky blacks, softened whites, pastel muted colours, gentle warmth.
codes.hint: fade .16 highlight .07; saturation .72; temperature +.08; contrast .9; grain .04; slight rose in shadows (color_balance shadows (.03,0,.01)).

codes.desc_uz: Tungi kino plyonkasi: yorqin joylar atrofida qizil halo (halation), volfram tuslari.
codes.prompt_en: Emulate CineStill 800T film: tungsten-balanced cool tones with red-orange halation glowing around bright highlights, cinematic night feel.
codes.hint: temperature -.2 base with warm highlights (split_tone #16233f / #ffd9a0 .35); halation(sigma 50, strength .75, #ff4a2a, threshold .62) — halo must be visible around sky patches/bright spots; contrast 1.08; grain .05.

codes.desc_uz: Klassik sepiya: jigarrang monoxrom, yumshoq kontrast va nozik vinetka.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a classic sepia-toned photograph: warm brown monochrome, soft contrast, gentle vignette.
codes.hint: sepia strength 1; curve s_curve .12; vignette .35 #1a0e06; grain .04; tiny fade .04.

codes.desc_uz: Eskirgan surat: sarg‘aygan qog‘oz, tirnalishlar, chang, xiralashgan burchaklar.
codes.prompt_en: Age the photo like a photograph from decades ago: yellowed faded tones, scratches, dust specks, worn soft corners and paper texture.
codes.hint: tone #c8a878 strength .85 + fade .14; multiply paper(strength .25); screen scratches(30) at .45 and dust(600) at .5; vignette .5 #3a2a14 softness .9; soft_focus .2; darken/blotch corners with fbm-based stains multiply (.15). Must clearly read as aged.

codes.desc_uz: Plyonka kamerasidagi nur sizishi: chetdan kirgan olovrang-qizil shu’la.
codes.prompt_en: Add an analog light leak: warm orange-red light bleeding in from one edge, slightly faded film colours.
codes.hint: light_leak(#ff6a2a, side right, strength .8) + a second smaller pink leak top-left (#ff9ac0 .4); fade .08; grain .04; saturation .95. The leak must be obvious.

codes.desc_uz: Gollivud gradatsiyasi: soyalar ko‘k-yashil, teri apelsin tusda — kino kadri.
codes.prompt_en: Apply the classic Hollywood teal-and-orange colour grade: teal shadows, warm orange skin tones, punchy cinematic contrast.
codes.hint: split_tone #0f4d5c / #ff9b45 strength .55; hsl_adjust greens 120 width 50 shift +25 sat .7 (foliage toward teal-olive); s_curve .15; skin protect: reduce effect on face_skin by 30%.

codes.desc_uz: Film-noir: chuqur qora soyalar, yuqori kontrastli oq-qora va sirli kayfiyat.
codes.prompt_en: Turn it into a film-noir still: high-contrast black and white, deep blacks, dramatic shadows, subtle grain.
codes.hint: bw(.25,.6,.15); s_curve .35; levels black .06 white .95; a diagonal shadow band across bottom-left (multiply .35 via linear mask); vignette .55; grain .07.

codes.desc_uz: Qorong‘i, xira, yashil-ko‘k tusli “moody” gradatsiya — chuqur va his-tuyg‘uli.
codes.prompt_en: Give it a dark moody grade: darker exposure, desaturated greens and teals in the shadows, soft contrast, atmospheric mood.
codes.hint: exposure -.5; saturation .65; split_tone #12302e / #c9b8a0 .4; hsl_adjust greens shift -10 sat .6 lum -.08; fade .05; vignette .45; clarity .15.

codes.desc_uz: Kino formatidagi qora chiziqlar va nafis kino gradatsiyasi — kadr filmdan olingan kabi.
codes.prompt_en: Present the photo as a cinematic movie frame: widescreen black bars, film-like colour grade, slight grain.
codes.hint: letterbox to visible ratio 1.0 (bars ~144px top/bottom black); inside: split_tone #1d3a4a / #f0b070 .35, s_curve .12, grain .05, slight vignette. Optional small subtitle text centred just above the lower bar in lato ~30px white: "— bu yerda hikoya boshlanadi".

codes.desc_uz: Katta byudjetli film uslubi: kuchli kontrast, sovuq yorug‘ joylar, iliq teri, keskin detallar.
codes.prompt_en: Grade like a big-budget action film: strong contrast, crushed blacks, cool highlights with warm skin, sharp crisp detail.
codes.hint: s_curve .3; levels black .05; split_tone #10253a / #ffc18a .45; clarity .45; sharpen .5; saturation 1.05; grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Simmetrik “pastel kino” estetikasi: pushti, yalpiz, sariq — yumshoq va nostaljik.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in a whimsical pastel film style: soft pink and mint palette, lifted shadows, low contrast, gentle yellow highlights.
codes.hint: fade .12; contrast .85; hsl_adjust greens shift -25 sat .8 lum +.1 (mint); split_tone #d9a0b8 / #fff0b8 .45; saturation .9; brightness +.04.

codes.desc_uz: Neon shahar tuni: bir tomondan pushti-magenta, boshqa tomondan moviy nur — zamonaviy noir.
codes.prompt_en: Relight as neo-noir: night-dark base with magenta neon light from one side and cyan-blue from the other, glossy high contrast.
codes.hint: exposure -.9; saturation .7; screen linear(angle 0) left->right magenta #ff2a8a .55 (weighted to left) and cyan #22c8ff .55 (weighted to right) using edge/person emphasis: multiply the neon layers by (0.5 + 0.5*inner_edge(person)); s_curve .2; glow .3; grain .04.

codes.desc_uz: Kumushrang, kuchli kontrastli, kam to‘yingan “bleach bypass” kino texnikasi.
codes.prompt_en: Apply a bleach-bypass film effect: strongly desaturated silvery tones with high contrast and gritty detail.
codes.hint: saturation .35; overlay gray(img) onto img at .7; s_curve .25; clarity .3; grain .07; slight cool.

codes.desc_uz: Anamorf linza: gorizontal ko‘k chaqnash chizig‘i va oval bokeh — haqiqiy kino optikasi.
codes.prompt_en: Add anamorphic lens character: a horizontal blue lens-flare streak across the frame at eye level, oval bokeh and a subtle cinematic grade.
codes.hint: blur_background sigma 10 (mild) then stretch bokeh: apply motion_blur(length 20, angle 0) to background only; blue streak: gaussian band across full width at eye level (y = eye_r y), thickness ~12px core + 60px soft, colour #3e8cff, screen .9; teal/orange .3; letterbox 1.0 optional (do not).

codes.desc_uz: Epik fantaziya filmi: sovuq soyalar, oltin yorug‘lik, kam to‘yingan dramatik gradatsiya.
codes.prompt_en: Grade like an epic dark fantasy film: desaturated cold shadows, golden highlights, dramatic vignette and crisp detail.
codes.hint: saturation .6; split_tone #0e1a2e / #d9a64a .55; s_curve .2; clarity .4; vignette .5; rays() from top-right screen .25 gold; grain .04.

codes.desc_uz: Muvozanatli, toza klassik oq-qora portret — har doim dolzarb.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a classic balanced black-and-white portrait with natural tonal range and clean detail.
codes.hint: bw(.3,.59,.11); s_curve .1; slight clarity .15. Nothing else.

codes.desc_uz: Yuqori kontrast: to‘q qoralar, yorqin oqlar, keskin, jasur portret.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to high-contrast black and white: deep blacks, bright whites, punchy and bold.
codes.hint: bw(.35,.5,.15); s_curve .35; levels black .05 white .96; clarity .35; sharpen .3.

codes.desc_uz: Havodor, yorug‘ va mayin oq-qora — yumshoq soyalar va yengil porlash.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a soft, airy high-key black and white: light tones, gentle shadows, subtle glow.
codes.hint: bw; fade .1; brightness +.06; contrast .9; glow .3 threshold .5; NO vignette.

codes.desc_uz: Donador oq-qora plyonka (Ilford uslubi): boy yarim tuslar va analog tekstura.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to grainy black-and-white 35mm film (Ilford style): rich midtones, visible grain, slight vignette.
codes.hint: bw(.28,.6,.12); s_curve .18; grain .12 size 1.5; vignette .35; fade .04.

codes.desc_uz: Surat oq-qora, faqat qizil ranglar (kiyim, lablar) rangli qoladi — kuchli vizual urg‘u.
codes.prompt_en: Make the photo black and white but keep only the red colours (the red sleeve and lips) in full colour.
codes.hint: isolate_hue(hue 0, width 28) — verify the red sleeve and lips stay red and everything else is grey; boost kept reds sat 1.15; s_curve .1.

codes.desc_uz: Kumush-jelatin bosma: salqin kumushrang tuslar, boy yarim tonlar, qog‘oz oqligi.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a silver-gelatin print look: cool silvery tones, rich midtones, paper-white highlights.
codes.hint: bw; split_tone #1a2230 / #e8eef5 .35 (cool); s_curve .15; levels white .97; very fine grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Matoviy, xira qoralar bilan oq-qora — zamonaviy tahririy uslub.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a matte black and white: lifted faded blacks, softened whites, modern editorial feel.
codes.hint: bw; fade .17 highlight .06; contrast .95; grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Nurli, yuqori kalitli oq-qora: yorug‘ joylar mayin porlaydi.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a glowing high-key black and white with soft bloom on the highlights.
codes.hint: bw; brightness +.05; glow(35, .6, .5); orton .25; contrast .95.

codes.desc_uz: Infraqizil surat: barglar oppoq, osmon qora, yuz mayin porlaydi — sirli ko‘rinish.
codes.prompt_en: Simulate infrared black-and-white photography: foliage turns bright white, sky goes dark, skin glows softly.
codes.hint: lighten greens strongly before bw: hsl_adjust hue 120 width 50 lum +.6 sat 0; darken blues/cyan hue 210 width 50 lum -.5; then bw(.2,.7,.1); glow .35; grain .05; s_curve .1. Foliage must be near white.

codes.desc_uz: Selen tusli iliq-jigarrang oq-qora — klassik va nafis.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a warm-toned black and white (selenium/brown tint), classic and elegant.
codes.hint: bw; split_tone #2b1810 / #f3e4cf .45; s_curve .12; fine grain .03; vignette .2.

codes.desc_uz: Uyg‘un iliq palitra: oltin yorug‘ joylar, mayin jigarrang soyalar.
codes.prompt_en: Colour grade with cosy warm tones: golden highlights, soft brown shadows, gentle warmth on the skin.
codes.hint: temperature +.3; split_tone #4a2e20 / #ffd9a0 .35; vibrance .1.

codes.desc_uz: Toza sovuq palitra: moviy soyalar, kumushrang yorug‘lik — zamonaviy va tinch.
codes.prompt_en: Colour grade with clean cool tones: blue-tinted shadows, silvery highlights, modern calm feel.
codes.hint: temperature -.3; split_tone #1a3050 / #dfeeff .35; saturation .9.

codes.desc_uz: Yumshoq pastel ranglar: yengil pushti va yalpiz tuslar, past kontrast.
codes.prompt_en: Grade into soft pastel colours: light pink and mint tints, lifted shadows, low contrast, dreamy.
codes.hint: fade .12; contrast .85; saturation .85; split_tone #c8a8d8 / #ffe6ee .4; hsl greens shift -20 lum +.1.

codes.desc_uz: To‘yingan, yorqin va jonli ranglar — yoz kayfiyati.
codes.prompt_en: Make the colours vibrant and punchy: boosted saturation, clarity and contrast, lively summer feel.
codes.hint: vibrance .5; saturation 1.15; clarity .3; s_curve .12. Skin must not turn orange — reduce saturation gain on face_skin by half.

codes.desc_uz: Kam to‘yingan, tinch va nafis ranglar — “quiet luxury” kayfiyati.
codes.prompt_en: Mute the colours: low saturation, soft contrast, warm brownish shadows, calm elegant mood.
codes.hint: saturation .6; contrast .92; split_tone #3a2a22 / #e8dcc8 .3; fade .06.

codes.desc_uz: Terrakota, zaytun, qum ranglari — tabiiy, iliq “earthy” palitra.
codes.prompt_en: Shift the palette to earthy tones: terracotta, olive, sand and warm brown; natural and organic.
codes.hint: hsl greens 120 width 50 shift +30 sat .7 (olive); reds/oranges sat 1.1 shift -5; temperature +.2; split_tone #3d2b1f / #d9b48a .35; saturation .9.

codes.desc_uz: Shaftoli-pushti iliq tuslar: yumshoq, tabiiy va nafis teri rangi.
codes.prompt_en: Grade with peachy warm tones: soft peach highlights, rosy warmth on the skin, gentle fade.
codes.hint: split_tone #6a3a3a / #ffc9a8 .45; temperature +.15; fade .06; brightness +.03.

codes.desc_uz: Pushti-oltin jilo: nafis pushti yarim tuslar va oltin yorug‘ joylar.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in rose-gold tones: pink midtones, golden shimmering highlights, soft glow.
codes.hint: split_tone #6b2f45 / #ffd8b0 .5; color_balance midtones (.05,0,.02); glow .25; vibrance .1.

codes.desc_uz: Chuqur zumrad yashil tuslar: boy, hashamatli va teatral.
codes.prompt_en: Grade with deep emerald tones: rich saturated greens, dark teal shadows, luxurious contrast.
codes.hint: hsl greens 120 width 50 sat 1.5 shift -5 lum -.05; split_tone #0a3328 / #d9ecd0 .4; s_curve .15; skin protected.

codes.desc_uz: Orzuli lavanda-binafsha tus: sovuq, mayin va romantik.
codes.prompt_en: Grade with a dreamy lavender tint: soft purple in the shadows and highlights, cool and romantic.
codes.hint: split_tone #3a2a6a / #e6d8ff .45; temperature -.1; saturation .9; fade .05; glow .2.

codes.desc_uz: Teri va yorug‘ joylarda orzuli mayin porlash — romantik portretning klassikasi.
codes.prompt_en: Add a soft dreamy glow: gentle bloom on the skin and highlights, slightly softened detail, romantic feel.
codes.hint: orton(sigma 30, .45); glow(40, .4, .55); brightness +.02. Visible but not blurry-blind.

codes.desc_uz: Yengil oq tuman va past kontrast: xuddi tushdagi kabi yumshoq kadr.
codes.prompt_en: Add a dreamy haze: soft white mist, lowered contrast, glowing light, ethereal atmosphere.
codes.hint: screen a haze: linear(angle 90 top->bottom) inverted * #fff4e8 at .35 plus uniform .12; contrast .85; glow .3; slight warm.

codes.desc_uz: Yorug‘ joylar kuchli porlaydi — nur atrofga tarqaladi.
codes.prompt_en: Add strong highlight bloom: bright areas glow and spill soft light into the surroundings.
codes.hint: glow(sigma 55, strength .8, threshold .5) + glow(sigma 15, .4, .7); slight brightness. Should be clearly stronger than /soft_glow.

codes.desc_uz: Butun suratga nozik pushti parda — muloyim va romantik.
codes.prompt_en: Add a delicate rose-pink tint over the whole image, warm and romantic.
codes.hint: blend #ffb6c8 soft_light .5 + screen .12; temperature +.1; fade .04.

codes.desc_uz: Iliq, xira, mayin porlagan plyonka — eski sevgi hikoyasi kabi.
codes.prompt_en: Create a vintage romantic film look: warm faded tones, soft glow, gentle vignette, nostalgic.
codes.hint: fade .12; temperature +.25; split_tone #5a3040 / #ffd9b8 .4; orton .3; vignette .35 #2a1418; grain .04.

codes.desc_uz: Marvariddek nurli teri: yorug‘, salqin-oq yorug‘ joylar va mayin tekstura.
codes.prompt_en: Make the skin look pearly and luminous: brightened soft highlights, cool-white glow, refined texture.
codes.hint: skin_smooth .5; brighten face_skin +.06; split_tone #4a4a5a / #f4f6ff .3 on skin; glow .3 threshold .6; saturation .92.

codes.desc_uz: Yorug‘, efirdek portret: boshning orqasida yumshoq oq halo va nurli fon.
codes.prompt_en: Make it ethereal and angelic: bright airy light, a soft white halo of light behind the head, glowing highlights.
codes.hint: halo = radial(centre at face_center shifted up by 120px, radius .75, softness .9) * background mask -> screen white .8; brightness +.06; glow .4; saturation .9; fade .06.

codes.desc_uz: Eski qog‘oz teksturasi, krem tus va yumshoq chetlar — maktub ichidagi surat.
codes.prompt_en: Style it like a photo tucked into an old love letter: cream paper texture, warm faded tone, soft worn edges.
codes.hint: tone #d8b990 strength .5 + fade .1; multiply paper(strength .22); vignette .45 #c9b28a softness .95 (light, not dark); small drawn corner flourishes optional; grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Juda yumshoq, oqargan, sokin tuslar — pichirlashdek nozik portret.
codes.prompt_en: Make the image very soft, pale and quiet: low contrast, pale cream and pink tones, hushed and delicate.
codes.hint: fade .2 highlight .08; contrast .8; saturation .7; brightness +.06; split_tone #b89aa0 / #fff3ec .4; orton .2.

codes.desc_uz: Yonoqlarda tabiiy pushti qizarish va iliq-pushti umumiy tus.
codes.prompt_en: Add a natural rosy blush on the cheeks and a warm pink overall tone.
codes.hint: cheek points: between eye and mouth (from meta: eye_l/eye_r and mouth), place two soft radial blobs (radius ~.14, softness .9) tinted #ff7a8a soft_light .6 restricted by face_skin; overall split_tone #5a3a45 / #ffe0e0 .3; slight warm.

codes.desc_uz: Eski kutubxona kayfiyati: jigarrang, qorong‘i, vintage donadorlik.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in dark-academia aesthetic: moody brown tones, darker exposure, vintage grain, old-library feel.
codes.hint: exposure -.4; saturation .7; split_tone #2a1a10 / #c8a878 .5; s_curve .15; grain .07; vignette .45; temperature +.15.

codes.desc_uz: Krem-bejeviy, yorug‘, yumshoq va iliq — nafis “light academia” uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in light-academia aesthetic: creamy beige tones, bright soft light, low saturation, warm elegance.
codes.hint: brightness +.08; saturation .75; split_tone #7a6a58 / #fff2dc .45; fade .08; contrast .9.

codes.desc_uz: Qishloq nostalgiyasi: yumshoq yashil, iliq nur, yengil tuman va plyonka.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in cottagecore aesthetic: soft warm greens, gentle sunlight, light haze, nostalgic film feel.
codes.hint: hsl greens shift +12 sat .85 lum +.05; temperature +.2; screen haze #fff0d0 .15 top; glow .25; grain .04; fade .05.

codes.desc_uz: 2000-yillar jilosi: yuqori to‘yinganlik, magenta-cyan, uchqunlar va chaqnash.
codes.prompt_en: Style in Y2K aesthetic: glossy high saturation, magenta and cyan tints, sparkles and a lens flare.
codes.hint: saturation 1.3; split_tone #2a1a60 / #ff9ad0 .4; chromatic_aberration 4; sparkle_layer at eyes/teeth/highlights + random 8 sparkles screen; lens_flare small top-left .5; glow .3.

codes.desc_uz: Toza, yorug‘, minimalistik: tabiiy teri porlashi, neytral oqlar.
codes.prompt_en: Style in clean-girl aesthetic: bright clean light, natural glowing skin, neutral whites, minimal and fresh.
codes.hint: brightness +.06; skin_smooth .35; saturation .95; temperature -.05; glow .2 threshold .65; clarity .1.

codes.desc_uz: Sokin hashamat: xira, nafis, iliq-krem yorug‘lik, chuqur soyalar, yengil plyonka.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in old-money quiet-luxury aesthetic: muted elegant tones, warm cream highlights, deep shadows, light film grain.
codes.hint: saturation .72; split_tone #1f1a18 / #f2e6d2 .4; s_curve .12; grain .04; vignette .3; temperature +.1.

codes.desc_uz: Pushti, nozik, porloq: yengil pushti parda, uchqunlar va yumshoq nur.
codes.prompt_en: Style in coquette aesthetic: soft pink wash, delicate sparkles, gentle glow, sweet and feminine.
codes.hint: blend #ffc0d0 soft_light .55; brightness +.04; glow .35; sparkle_layer 10 small sparkles screen; fade .05.

codes.desc_uz: Qo‘pol, qorong‘i, teksturali: kuchli kontrast, donadorlik, tirnalishlar.
codes.prompt_en: Style in grunge aesthetic: gritty dark tones, heavy contrast, rough grain, scratches and dirty texture.
codes.hint: saturation .6; s_curve .3; grain .12 size 1.4; screen scratches(40) .5; multiply fbm-based dirt (.25); vignette .5; slight green-yellow tint.

codes.desc_uz: Matoviy tahririy uslub: xira qoralar, past kontrast, salqin tus.
codes.prompt_en: Give the photo a matte editorial look: faded blacks, low contrast, slightly cool tones.
codes.hint: fade .15 highlight .05; contrast .9; temperature -.08; saturation .9.

codes.desc_uz: Mustaqil kino estetikasi: yashil-sariq tus, xira ranglar, plyonka donalari.
codes.prompt_en: Grade like an indie film: green-yellow tinted highlights, faded colours, film grain, slightly cool shadows.
codes.hint: split_tone #23303a / #e8e29a .45; fade .08; saturation .85; grain .07; s_curve .08.

codes.desc_uz: Teri tekis va silliq, lekin tabiiy tekstura saqlanadi — professional retush.
codes.prompt_en: Retouch the skin: smooth and even it out while keeping natural texture and pores, no plastic look.
codes.hint: skin_smooth strength .85 radius 16 keep_texture .3; slight brighten skin +.02. Compare with original: visibly smoother cheeks, still natural.

codes.desc_uz: Ko‘zlar yorqinroq va aniqroq: oqi tozalanadi, rangdor pardasi jonlanadi.
codes.prompt_en: Brighten and sharpen the eyes: whiten the eye whites slightly, enhance iris colour and contrast, add sparkle.
codes.hint: eyes mask: brightness +.1, saturation .95 on whites; iris mask: saturation 1.4, contrast 1.25, sharpen .8; small catchlight sparkle (sparkle_layer tiny at iris centres, size 14) screen .7. Rest untouched.

codes.desc_uz: Tishlar tabiiy oqartiriladi: sarg‘ish tus ketadi, kulgi yorqinroq bo‘ladi.
codes.prompt_en: Whiten the teeth naturally: remove yellow tint and brighten them without looking fake.
codes.hint: mouth mask: hsl desaturate yellows (sat .35) + brightness +.12 + slight cool; feather 1.5. Verify on the smile — teeth clearly whiter, lips unchanged.

codes.desc_uz: Yuz konturi: yonoq suyaklari va burun ko‘prigi yoritiladi, yuz cheti va jag‘ chizig‘i soyalanadi.
codes.prompt_en: Contour the face with dodge and burn: brighten cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead centre; softly darken jawline and face edges.
codes.hint: dodge (screen white .18) on soft blobs: forehead centre, nose bridge, upper cheeks under eyes, chin; burn (multiply #5a4030 .25) on inner_edge(face mask, width 60, softness 30) and under cheekbones; all restricted to face_skin; subtle but visible. Use meta() points.

codes.desc_uz: Klassik “soft focus” portret: yumshoq, romantik, nurli.
codes.prompt_en: Apply a classic soft-focus portrait effect: gently softened detail with a luminous glow, still sharp enough.
codes.hint: soft_focus sigma 14 mix .45; glow .3; brightness +.02.

codes.desc_uz: Mahalliy kontrast va detallar kuchayadi — surat aniq va “chuqur” ko‘rinadi.
codes.prompt_en: Boost clarity: enhance local contrast and midtone detail so the photo looks crisp and dimensional.
codes.hint: clarity .55 radius 40; sharpen .3; vibrance .1. Avoid halos on the face — reduce on face_skin by 40%.

codes.desc_uz: Nozik detallar (ko‘z, ro‘mol to‘qimasi, barglar) keskin va tiniq bo‘ladi.
codes.prompt_en: Sharpen the photo: crisp fine detail in the eyes, fabric and background, without artifacts.
codes.hint: unsharp radius 1.5 amount 1.1 threshold .01 + detail_enhance blended .35. Compare: visibly crisper.

codes.desc_uz: Nam, porloq “dewy” teri: yonoq va burun ustida yorug‘ shu’la.
codes.prompt_en: Give the skin a dewy glow: luminous highlights on the cheekbones and nose, healthy radiant look.
codes.hint: on face_skin: glow(20, .6, .55) + add highlights: smoothstep(.6,.9,lum)*.25 screen white; warm +.08; skin_smooth .3.

codes.desc_uz: Yog‘li yaltirash olib tashlanadi, teri tekis matoviy bo‘ladi.
codes.prompt_en: Mattify the skin: remove shine and specular highlights, even out the tone, soft matte finish.
codes.hint: on face_skin: compress highlights (curve [(0,0),(.7,.66),(1,.9)]); skin_smooth .5; saturation .95; slight powder tint. Nothing outside the skin changes.

codes.desc_uz: To‘liq professional retush: silliq teri, yorqin ko‘zlar, oq tishlar, kontur va nafis rang.
codes.prompt_en: Do a complete professional portrait retouch: smooth skin, bright eyes, white teeth, subtle contouring and refined colour, natural result.
codes.hint: combine: skin_smooth .7; eyes brighten/sharpen; teeth whiten; light dodge&burn; clarity .15; split_tone warm .15; vignette .15.

codes.desc_uz: Portret rejimi: fon chiroyli xiralashadi, odam keskin qoladi.
codes.prompt_en: Blur the background like a portrait-mode lens: subject stays sharp, background softly out of focus.
codes.hint: blur_background sigma 22; slight clarity on person .15. Edges of hijab must stay clean (no halo).

codes.desc_uz: Yumshoq, kremdek bokeh: fondagi yorug‘ nuqtalar dumaloq disklarga aylanadi.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background focus with creamy bokeh: round bright discs from the light spots, dreamy shallow depth of field.
codes.hint: blur_background method bokeh radius 26 highlight_boost 4; then screen bokeh_layer(25, colors warm/gold, area=background mask) .5; slight warm.

codes.desc_uz: Toza oq studiya foni — katalog va rasmiy portretlar uchun.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background with a clean white studio backdrop with a soft natural shadow, keep the subject perfectly cut out.
codes.hint: replace_background with white gradient (#ffffff centre -> #ebe8e4 bottom/edges via radial), add soft shadow under the shoulders (blur of person mask shifted down, multiply .25); slight brighten subject +.02. Cut-out must look clean.

codes.desc_uz: Iliq krem-bejeviy studiya foni — yumshoq va nafis.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background with a warm cream studio backdrop, soft vignette, elegant and calm.
codes.hint: replace_background with cream #F3EADB -> #DCCDB7 radial; shadow like studio_white; temperature +.08 on subject.

codes.desc_uz: Bordo-pushti gradient fon — zamonaviy va jasur.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background with a smooth burgundy-to-rose gradient backdrop.
codes.hint: linear gradient angle 60: #4a1522 -> #a8556b -> #e8c4c8; replace_background; add subtle radial light behind head; slight rim light on person edge.

codes.desc_uz: Odam rangli, fon oq-qora — diqqat butunlay portretga qaratiladi.
codes.prompt_en: Keep the subject in full colour and make the background black and white.
codes.hint: lerp(gray(img), img, person mask); slight bg contrast .95; subject vibrance .1.

codes.desc_uz: Qorong‘i studiya va boshning orqasida yumshoq nur doirasi.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background with a dark studio and a soft circular spotlight glow behind the head.
codes.hint: bg = canvas #141012 + radial(centre above face, radius .55, softness .8) * #6b4a3a screen; replace_background; rim light on person edges .3; warm subject slightly.

codes.desc_uz: Fon krem rangli teksturali qog‘ozga almashadi — badiiy va issiq.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background with textured cream paper, subject unchanged.
codes.hint: bg = canvas(#efe4d2, paper(strength .28)) with soft vignette; replace_background; soft shadow under subject.

codes.desc_uz: Fon qorong‘ilashadi va xiralashadi — odam yorqin ajralib turadi.
codes.prompt_en: Darken and desaturate the background so the subject stands out bright.
codes.hint: on background mask: exposure -1.6, saturation .3, blur 4; subject +.03; vignette .2.

codes.desc_uz: Nafis bej naqshli fon (damask/lattice) — klassik interyer.
codes.prompt_en: Replace the background with an elegant subtle beige damask-style pattern.
codes.hint: procedural pattern: diagonal lattice (stripes at +45 and -45 period 90 thin) + small dots at intersections, colours #e6d9c4 on #efe5d5, low contrast, multiply paper; replace_background; soft shadow. Must read as wallpaper.

codes.desc_uz: Klassik moyli bo‘yoq: mo‘yqalam izlari, boy ranglar, kanvas teksturasi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a classic oil painting with visible brush strokes, rich colours and canvas texture.
codes.hint: cv_oil size 9 dyn 1 blended with detail; saturation 1.15; s_curve .1; multiply canvas texture (fbm fine + stripes weave cross-hatch low contrast .12); slight vignette. Brush look must be evident.

codes.desc_uz: Yumshoq akvarel: oqib ketgan ranglar, qog‘oz teksturasi va och konturlar.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a watercolour painting: soft bleeding colours, paper texture, light pencil outlines.
codes.hint: cv_stylization(80, .5) lightened & desaturated .85; multiply paper(strength .3); multiply xdog line layer at .6 (soft grey lines); white-ish paper vignette; lift blacks .1.

codes.desc_uz: Grafit qalam bilan chizilgan portret: nozik chiziqlar va shtrixlar.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a graphite pencil sketch with fine lines and delicate shading.
codes.hint: cv_pencil gray (sigma_s 70, sigma_r .08, shade .06); multiply paper .15; add xdog lines multiply .7; slight warm paper tint #f5f0e6.

codes.desc_uz: Qo‘pol ko‘mir chizmasi: to‘q soyalar, teksturali shtrixlar.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a bold charcoal drawing with dark rough shading and textured strokes.
codes.hint: bw; s_curve .3; multiply cv_pencil gray with gamma; add grain .15 size 2; xdog lines phi 20 multiply; paper texture; darker overall than pencil_sketch.

codes.desc_uz: Uorhol uslubidagi 2×2 panel: posterlangan jasur ranglar, har panel o‘z palitrasida.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into Warhol-style pop art: a 2x2 grid of posterized versions in bold contrasting colour palettes.
codes.hint: posterize luminance 4 levels; 4 gradient_maps with palettes e.g. (#2a0a3a,#ff2e7a,#ffe200), (#0a2a4a,#00c2ff,#ffffff), (#3a1a00,#ff7a00,#fff0a0), (#0a3a2a,#00e07a,#ffc0e0); tile 2x2 (each resized to W/2 x H/2), thin black gutters.

codes.desc_uz: Komiks uslubi: qora konturlar, nuqtali (halftone) soyalar, to‘yingan ranglar.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a comic-book illustration: black ink outlines, halftone dot shading, saturated flat colours.
codes.hint: posterize 5; saturation 1.3; multiply halftone(cell 12) at .5 only in shadows (weight by 1-lum); multiply edges (Canny dilate 2) black; slight paper.

codes.desc_uz: Gazeta bosmasi: surat turli o‘lchamdagi nuqtalardan iborat.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a newspaper halftone print made of dots of varying size.
codes.hint: halftone(cell 16, angle 25) in burgundy ink (#43121D) on cream (#F7F1E8) paper; add paper texture. Dots must be clearly visible.

codes.desc_uz: Minglab rangli nuqtalardan yig‘ilgan rasm — impressionistlar uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a pointillism painting made of thousands of small coloured dots.
codes.hint: draw ~50k random circles r 4-8 sampling colour from a slightly blurred image with saturation 1.2, on a cream canvas; sample colour jitter; smaller dots in face region (r 3-5) for detail.

codes.desc_uz: Yumshoq mo‘yqalam zarbalari, nurli ranglar — Mone uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into an impressionist painting with soft directional brush dabs and luminous colours.
codes.hint: stroke painting: many random short ellipses/lines (length 14-30, angle from local gradient or random), colours sampled from the image (sat 1.15, brightness +.05); base = cv_stylization; canvas texture. Recognisable face, painterly everywhere.

codes.desc_uz: Minimalistik qora siyoh chiziqlari krem qog‘ozda — nafis illyustratsiya.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a minimal black ink line drawing on cream paper.
codes.hint: xdog(sigma 1.2, p 18, eps .015, phi 12) lines in ink #1a1214 on cream canvas with paper(); add light wash of tone (gray*.15 multiply) so the face reads; small ink splatter optional.

codes.desc_uz: Bej stol ustidagi Polaroid: oq ramka, qo‘lyozma yozuv, biroz burilgan.
codes.prompt_en: Put the photo in an instant-camera frame lying on a beige table, slightly tilted, with a handwritten caption.
codes.hint: paste onto canvas(BEIGE, paper) size (760,950) border 44 bottom 200 rotate +4 shadow; caption cormorant-italic 64px #3a2a2a "yozgi kunlar ♡" on the bottom border; keep colours of the photo slightly warm.

codes.desc_uz: 35 mm plyonka lentasi: qora chetlar, perforatsiya teshiklari, kadr raqami.
codes.prompt_en: Present the photo as a frame on a 35mm film strip with sprocket holes and frame numbers.
codes.hint: black canvas #111; photo inset centred (W-140 wide); rows of rounded rectangles (sprocket holes) top & bottom in cream #e8e0d0; small text "KODAK 400  ▸ 24A" style in lato-bold 26px orange-ish along the edge; slight warm grade on the photo.

codes.desc_uz: Galereya uslubidagi toza oq ramka va nozik ichki chiziq.
codes.prompt_en: Add a clean white gallery-style border with a thin inner keyline.
codes.hint: inset 70 white; then thin burgundy keyline at 52px inset (2px). Photo slightly contrast+.

codes.desc_uz: Krem fonda yumaloq burchakli karta va yumshoq soya — ilova (app) uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Present the photo as a rounded-corner card with a soft shadow on a cream background.
codes.hint: paste onto canvas(CREAM) size (960,1200) radius 60 shadow (.3, 40, (0,24)); no border.

codes.desc_uz: Moda jurnali muqovasi: masthead, sarlavhalar, shtrix-kod — bordo va krem uslubda.
codes.prompt_en: Design the photo as a fashion-magazine cover with a masthead title, cover lines and a barcode.
codes.hint: masthead "ÉLÉGANCE" playfair-bold ~150px cream #F7F1E8 top centre (behind head partly OK); cover lines left/right bottom in lato-bold 34px + playfair-italic 44px; issue text "SENTABR 2026 · № 09"; barcode: thin vertical bars bottom-right; slight grade s_curve .1 ; small burgundy accent bar.

codes.desc_uz: Klassik ikki chiziqli ramka va burchak naqshlari — antiqa surat.
codes.prompt_en: Put the photo inside an ornate classic frame with double lines and corner flourishes, vintage style.
codes.hint: inset 90 on cream paper canvas; draw double lines (burgundy 3px + 1px) at 60/74px; corner ornaments: small drawn curls/lozenges (use ImageDraw arcs) in burgundy; photo grade: slight sepia .3 + vignette.

codes.desc_uz: Bir varaqda 4 ta bir xil surat — foto-budka (photo booth) uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Lay out the photo as a photo-booth sheet: 4 identical copies in a 2x2 grid with white gaps.
codes.hint: canvas white; 4 copies resized (W/2-60, H/2-60) with 40px gaps; slight bw or colour? keep colour with mild contrast; thin grey cut lines.

codes.desc_uz: Yirtilgan qog‘oz chetlari — kollaj uslubi, bej fonda.
codes.prompt_en: Style the photo as a torn paper cut-out collaged onto a beige background with rough white fibrous edges.
codes.hint: torn mask: rectangle inset ~70px with edges displaced by fbm noise (amplitude 25px) -> mask; white fibrous edge = dilate(mask,10)-mask tinted #f4efe6; paste over canvas(BEIGE, paper) with shadow; rotate 2 deg.

codes.desc_uz: Bordo va krem ikki qavatli ramka — gaydning o‘z uslubida.
codes.prompt_en: Add a double border: an outer cream mat and an inner burgundy frame line.
codes.hint: inset 80 cream; border ring burgundy 14px at 56px inset; thin inner line 2px cream inside it. Elegant.

codes.desc_uz: Vintage otkritka: marka, pochta muhri va “Salom!” yozuvi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a vintage postcard with a stamp, a postmark and a greeting text.
codes.hint: canvas cream paper; photo inset with white border 30, slight sepia .25 + fade; stamp: small rectangle with perforated edge top-right containing a mini copy of the photo (bw); postmark: circles + wavy lines in grey-black at low opacity; text "Salom!" playfair-italic 90px burgundy bottom-left.

codes.desc_uz: Raqamli buzilish: RGB kanallar surilgan, gorizontal bo‘laklar siljigan.
codes.prompt_en: Apply a digital glitch effect: RGB channel splitting, shifted horizontal slices, small blocks of corruption.
codes.hint: chromatic flat shift 14; ~12 random horizontal bands shifted ±20..80px (some with inverted or single-channel); a few thin scanline bands; small colour-block noise; keep face mostly readable.

codes.desc_uz: VHS kasseta: skan chiziqlari, rang oqishi, shovqin va “PLAY ▶” yozuvi.
codes.prompt_en: Apply a VHS tape look: scanlines, colour bleeding, tape noise, slight distortion and a "PLAY" overlay.
codes.hint: chroma bleed: blur chroma (blur only colour, keep luma) sigma 6 + shift 6px; scanlines period 4 .25; grain .08 colour; wobble: small horizontal jitter per line bands; text "▶ PLAY" top-left and "SP 0:12:47" bottom in lato-bold 46px white with slight glow; saturation .9; vignette .3.

codes.desc_uz: Siluet ichida daraxtlar: portret va tabiat bir kadrda uyg‘unlashadi.
codes.prompt_en: Create a double-exposure: the silhouette of the person filled with the trees/foliage of the background, over a light background.
codes.hint: inside = person mask; trees = the original background region (blur_background trick not needed): take img zoomed 1.3 (trees region), screen-blend into person area with weight .75; person area base brightened (levels) so trees show; outside person -> near-white #f2eee8 gradient; slight bw or muted colour; face must still be visible (weight less on face mask).

codes.desc_uz: Suratning pastki qismida suvdagi aks va yengil to‘lqinlar.
codes.prompt_en: Add a water reflection below the portrait: the image mirrored at the bottom with soft ripples fading out.
codes.hint: compose: top 62% = img resized; bottom = vertically flipped copy with sinusoidal horizontal displacement (ripples), blurred slightly, darkened .8, fading to a dark blue #0d1b2a at the very bottom; thin horizon line.

codes.desc_uz: Prizma orqali o‘tgan kamalak nur chiziqlari — jozibali refraktsiya.
codes.prompt_en: Add prism light effects: rainbow light streaks refracted across the photo, subtle chromatic edges.
codes.hint: diagonal rainbow bands: gradient through hues along an axis at 35deg, softened, screened .6 restricted to 2 bands; chromatic_aberration 6; glow .2; slight brighten.

codes.desc_uz: Linza rang chetlanishi: RGB kanallarning chetlarda ajralishi.
codes.prompt_en: Add strong chromatic aberration: red and blue colour fringing increasing toward the edges of the frame.
codes.hint: chromatic_aberration amount 22 radial; slight vignette; keep centre sharp. Must be clearly visible at the edges (hijab outline, trees).

codes.desc_uz: Retro o‘yin uslubi: yirik piksellar va cheklangan rang palitrasi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into 8-bit pixel art with large pixels and a limited retro colour palette.
codes.hint: pixelate block 18 then posterize 5 + saturation 1.2; optional 1px darker grid lines multiply .15.

codes.desc_uz: Radial harakat xiraligi: fon harakatda, yuz keskin — dinamika.
codes.prompt_en: Add radial motion blur to the background while the face stays sharp — dynamic energy.
codes.hint: zoom_blur strength .12 centred on face; then restore face/person via mask(person) feather 20 (person sharp); slight contrast.

codes.desc_uz: Quyoshdan tushgan linza chaqnashi: yorqin markaz, chiziqlar va ko‘pburchak sharpalar.
codes.prompt_en: Add a realistic sun lens flare from the top corner with a bright core, light streaks and polygon ghost artifacts.
codes.hint: lens_flare(pos top-right, strength 1.0) + temperature +.15 + slight haze; make the flare prominent.

codes.desc_uz: Kuygan plyonka chetlari: to‘q sariq-qizil olovli chetlar va oq kuyish nuqtalari.
codes.prompt_en: Add a film-burn effect: orange-red burning edges creeping in from the corners with bright white hot spots.
codes.hint: burn mask from fbm thresholded near two corners (top-right, bottom-left); layer: white core -> yellow -> orange -> dark red rings by distance; screen/add; slight warm overall, faded grain.

codes.desc_uz: Oltin kuz: yashil barglar apelsin-sariqqa aylanadi, iliq nur.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the scene into golden autumn: green foliage becomes orange and amber, warm low sunlight.
codes.hint: hsl greens hue 120 width 55 shift -75 (toward orange) sat 1.15 lum +.02; temperature +.25; split_tone #4a2a14 / #ffcf7a .35; glow .2. Foliage must be clearly orange.

codes.desc_uz: Sovuq qish: kumush-moviy tuslar, yengil qor yog‘ishi, ayozli havo.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the scene into a cold winter day: silvery-blue tones, desaturated foliage, gently falling snow.
codes.hint: hsl greens sat .15 lum +.25 (frosted); temperature -.35; brightness +.05; snow: 2 layers of blurred white dots (sizes 3-8 and 8-16, some motion_blur) screen .9 across whole image; slight haze; cool split_tone.

codes.desc_uz: Yangi bahor: yorqin yashil, pushti gullar tusi, havodor nur.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the scene into fresh spring: bright vivid greens, soft pink blossom tint, airy light.
codes.hint: hsl greens sat 1.3 lum +.08 shift -8; split_tone #4a5a3a / #ffe0ea .35; brightness +.04; scatter ~60 soft pink petal shapes (small rotated ellipses #ffb7c5, blurred 1-2px) mostly in the top/background; glow .2.

codes.desc_uz: Quyoshli yoz: jonli ranglar, iliq yorqin nur va quyosh shu’lasi.
codes.prompt_en: Make it a bright sunny summer day: vivid colours, warm bright light and a sun glow.
codes.hint: vibrance .4; temperature +.2; brightness +.05; lens_flare small (.4, no ghosts) top-right; s_curve .08.

codes.desc_uz: Yomg‘ir chiziqlari va nam shisha: moviy-kulrang, sokin kayfiyat.
codes.prompt_en: Add rain: streaks of falling rain, wet-glass droplets on the lens, cool blue-grey mood.
codes.hint: temperature -.25; saturation .8; exposure -.2; rain streaks: ~600 thin semi-transparent lines length 40-120 angle ~78deg, motion-blurred, screen .35; droplets: ~120 small refracting circles (slightly brighter rim); slight blur .8.

codes.desc_uz: Yumshoq tuman: fon oq tumanga cho‘madi, odam oldinda aniq.
codes.prompt_en: Add soft fog: the background fades into white mist while the subject stays clear in front.
codes.hint: fog = (background mask * .75 + .12) * (fbm(4) *.4 + .6) -> screen #eef0f2; desaturate background .6; contrast .9. Depth must be obvious.

codes.desc_uz: Tushayotgan oltin barglar va iliq kuz nuri — ertakdagi kabi.
codes.prompt_en: Add falling golden leaves drifting through warm autumn light.
codes.hint: base autumn grade (lighter); draw ~45 leaf shapes (ellipse with pointed ends via polygon, small vein line) colours #e8a33a/#d97a2b/#f2c65a, sizes 30-110, random rotation, some blurred (depth), a few in front of subject; warm glow.

codes.desc_uz: Kadr chetlarida muz kristallari va sovuq moviy tus.
codes.prompt_en: Add frost: icy crystal patterns creeping in from the edges of the frame and a cold blue tint.
codes.hint: edge weight = 1 - radial(radius 1.0, softness .7); frost = smoothstep on fbm(6, scale 3) high frequency * edge weight -> screen white-blue #e8f4ff .85; plus tiny sparkles; temperature -.3; saturation .85.

codes.desc_uz: Yuqori burchakdan tushayotgan quyosh nurlari (god rays) — ilohiy nur.
codes.prompt_en: Add sun rays (god rays) streaming diagonally from the top corner through the scene.
codes.hint: rays(centre top-right, count 18, sharpness) screen #ffe9b0 .7 with glow; warm +.15; slight haze; rays clearly visible across the face/background.

codes.desc_uz: Tungi sahna: to‘q ko‘k osmon, yulduzlar, odam yumshoq iliq nur bilan yoritilgan.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the scene into night: deep blue darkness, stars in the sky, the person softly lit by warm light.
codes.hint: background: exposure -2.2, temperature -.5, blue split; stars: ~150 tiny bright dots + 10 sparkles in the upper background (area = background mask * (y < 45%)); person: exposure -.5, warm radial light on face; glow; vignette .4.

codes.desc_uz: Eski plyonkadagi chang zarralari va tirnalishlar qatlami.
codes.prompt_en: Overlay vintage dust particles and scratches like an old film scan.
codes.hint: screen scratches(35, length (300,1200)) .55 + dust(900, size (1,3)) .6 + few hairs (curved lines); slight fade .06; grain .04.

codes.desc_uz: Surat teksturali qog‘ozga bosilgandek — tolalar va donachalar.
codes.prompt_en: Make the photo look printed on textured fibrous paper.
codes.hint: multiply paper(strength .35, fibers) ; fade .06; slight desat .92; edges slightly lighter (paper vignette light).

codes.desc_uz: Havoda suzayotgan oltin bokeh doiralari — bayram kayfiyati.
codes.prompt_en: Add floating golden bokeh light circles across the photo, festive and warm.
codes.hint: screen bokeh_layer(45, radius (25,110), colors gold/peach/white, softness .3) .8; warm +.1; slight glow. Discs must be visible over the whole frame, fewer over the face.

codes.desc_uz: Yorug‘ nuqtalarda porlab turgan yulduzchalar — ko‘z va tabassumda.
codes.prompt_en: Add twinkling sparkle stars on the bright points (eyes, smile) and a few in the scene.
codes.hint: sparkle_layer at iris centres (size 40), teeth (2 points, 30), + 12 random on highlights (lum>.8) sizes 20-70; screen .9 with glow; slight brightness.

codes.desc_uz: Nozik glitter yaltirog‘i butun surat bo‘ylab — bayramona jilo.
codes.prompt_en: Add fine glitter shimmer scattered across the image, with a subtle warm sheen.
codes.hint: thousands of tiny 1-3px bright specks (white/gold/pink) with slight blur, density higher on clothing/background, screen .85; a few small sparkles; temperature +.08; glow .15.

codes.desc_uz: Diagonal yumshoq nur tasmalari kadr bo‘ylab o‘tadi.
codes.prompt_en: Add soft diagonal beams of light passing across the frame.
codes.hint: two or three wide soft bands via stripes(angle 30, period 500, duty .3, softness 120) * linear gradient from top-left -> screen #fff0d0 .5; warm +.1; slight haze.

codes.desc_uz: Jalyuzi orqali tushgan nur va soya chiziqlari — klassik noir/estetik kadr.
codes.prompt_en: Add venetian-blind light and shadow stripes across the subject and background.
codes.hint: stripes(angle -8, period 110, duty .5, softness 10) multiply .55 (darken between stripes) + lit stripes screen warm #ffe6c0 .2; contrast 1.05; skip nothing — stripes cross the face too (that is the look).

codes.desc_uz: Daraxt barglari orqali tushgan quyosh soyalari (gobo) — yoz tushi.
codes.prompt_en: Add dappled sunlight through leaves: leaf-shaped shadows and warm light patches across the image.
codes.hint: leaf shadow mask: draw ~200 leaf shapes (rotated ellipses with pointed ends) union, blur 8; multiply shadow #4a3a2a at .5; lit areas screen warm .2; temperature +.15.

codes.desc_uz: Dantel naqshli soya — romantik, nafis nur o‘yini.
codes.prompt_en: Add a lace-pattern shadow falling across the photo, romantic and delicate.
codes.hint: procedural lace: grid of circles (rings) + scallops + small dots, period ~120px, rotated 12 deg, blur 5 -> multiply .45; warm light in gaps; optional slight perspective (rotate 5).

codes.desc_uz: Iliq quyosh tumani: kontrast pasayadi, yorug‘lik havoda tarqaladi.
codes.prompt_en: Add warm sun haze: reduced contrast, warm light scattered through the air, dreamy summer atmosphere.
codes.hint: screen linear(top->bottom inverted) * #ffd9a8 .4 + uniform .1; contrast .85; temperature +.2; glow .25; slight lens flare (no ghosts) .3.

codes.desc_uz: Ikki rangli portret: bordo soyalar va krem yorug‘lik — gaydning imzo uslubi.
codes.prompt_en: Convert to a two-colour duotone: burgundy shadows and cream highlights.
codes.hint: duotone(#43121D, #F7F1E8) via gradient_map with mid stop #A8556B at .55; s_curve .1; slight grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Qorong‘i fonda odamning neon porlovchi konturi — pushti va moviy.
codes.prompt_en: Draw glowing neon outlines of the subject in pink and cyan on a dark background.
codes.hint: base: exposure -1.4 desat .5 dark; outline = edges of person mask + Canny of face details -> dilate 2 -> glow (blur 3 + blur 12 + blur 30) coloured #ff2fa0 on the left half, #22d3ff on the right half; screen strongly. Face still visible in the dark.

codes.desc_uz: Kelajak shahar: magenta-cyan neon gradatsiya, yuqori kontrast, yengil skan chiziqlar.
codes.prompt_en: Grade in cyberpunk style: magenta and cyan neon split tones, high contrast, glow and faint scanlines.
codes.hint: split_tone #12d0ff / #ff2fa0 .6 (cool shadows magenta highlights) then hsl greens shift -60 sat .8; s_curve .25; glow .35; scanlines period 6 .12; grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Trafaret (screen-print) poster: 4 rangli posterizatsiya, halftone va qog‘oz.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a retro screen-printed poster: 4-colour posterized palette, halftone shading, paper texture.
codes.hint: posterize lum 4 -> gradient_map (#2b1a1a, #6B1F2E, #d98a4a, #F2E4C8); multiply halftone(cell 10) .35 in mid/dark; paper multiply .3; misregister slightly one colour layer (+3px). Bold poster feel.

codes.desc_uz: Pushti-binafsha-cyan gradient, pastda neon to‘r — 80-yillar kelajagi.
codes.prompt_en: Style in vaporwave aesthetic: pink-purple-cyan gradient tones, a neon perspective grid at the bottom, retro glow.
codes.hint: gradient_map (#1a0b3a, #7a2a9a, #ff6ec7, #8ef5ff) .8 mixed with original .35; perspective grid in the lower 30% (converging lines, magenta) screen; sun-stripe circle top optional; glow .3; chromatic 4.

codes.desc_uz: Issiqlik kamerasi: ko‘k → binafsha → qizil → sariq → oq spektri.
codes.prompt_en: Render as a thermal-camera image: heat-map colours from blue through purple, red and yellow to white.
codes.hint: gradient_map on luminance (blur 3): (#000428 0, #2a0a6a .2, #8a0a8a .4, #ff2a2a .6, #ffb020 .8, #ffffff 1); slight posterize 12; small text "FLIR 36.6°C" corner optional.

codes.desc_uz: Plyonka negativi: ranglar teskari, apelsin plyonka asosi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a colour film negative with inverted colours and an orange film base tint.
codes.hint: invert; then multiply with orange base #ffa050 at .35 + slight fade; add film-strip edge text optional; contrast .95.

codes.desc_uz: Sabattier effekti: yorug‘ joylar qisman teskari — syurreal metall jilo.
codes.prompt_en: Apply solarization (Sabattier effect): partially inverted highlights for a surreal metallic look.
codes.hint: solarize threshold .55 on a slightly desaturated image; then s_curve .15; slight cool split; grain .03.

codes.desc_uz: Ikki rangli rizograf bosma: bordo + ko‘k qatlamlar biroz siljigan, donador.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a two-colour risograph print: burgundy and navy ink layers slightly misregistered, grainy.
codes.hint: two ink layers: layer1 = gradient_map bw-> (#F2E8DA, #6B1F2E) from luminance; layer2 = (#F2E8DA,#1f3a6b) from (1-red channel) shifted +6px; multiply layers over paper; grain .1 size 2; halftone-ish noise; paper texture.

codes.desc_uz: Perforatsiyali pochta markasi: bordo gravyura uslubi va “POST” yozuvi.
codes.prompt_en: Turn the photo into a postage stamp: perforated edges, engraved-line monochrome look in burgundy ink, and a denomination text.
codes.hint: engraving: bw + s_curve; multiply stripes(angle 20, period 6, duty .5) modulated by luminance (lines thicker in dark areas) -> burgundy ink on cream; stamp perforation: canvas cream with a rounded-perforation edge (row of circles cut out) around inset 70; text "O‘ZBEKISTON  ·  2026" lato-bold and "150" playfair-bold in burgundy.
